title: Governor's Summer Internship Program (GSIP)
sponsor: UMBC Shriver Center with the Maryland Office of the Governor
who_text: College students who will be juniors or seniors during the summer, with a GPA of 2.7 or higher, who attend a Maryland school or are Maryland residents at an out-of-state school
description: You work full time in a Maryland state government agency for the summer with a senior mentor. You research a policy question and present a recommendation to the Governor. Applications for summer 2027 open in fall 2026.
